description:
Open an account for the owner when the owner asks for one. Action signup sends the owner one email with an 8-digit code, and action confirm with that code answers the key once. The key starts read-only, and payments stay off until the owner turns them on.
Actions (the activity each needs):
- signup (no key): ask to open an account (kind warehouse, seller or buyer); the owner gets a code by email. It answers the signup id, the email, the time the code expires (30 minutes later) and the next step.
- confirm (no key): the email and the 8-digit code; answers the key once.
Send action and its arguments. With a key, or with ?role=buyer, seller, warehouse or all, the server also lists the separate tools that list, order, pay and ship.

address.description: For signup. A warehouse: the street address of its first facility.

city.description: For signup. A warehouse: the city of its first facility.

code.description: For confirm. The 8-digit code from the email the owner received.

company.description: For signup. The business name. Required for a warehouse or a seller; optional for a buyer.

email.description: For every action. The owner’s email; the code goes there.

kind.description: For signup. The kind of account: warehouse, seller, or buyer (a Shop account that buys on the market).

services.description: For signup. A warehouse: the services it offers, one short phrase each (for example pick and pack).

sqft.description: For signup. A warehouse: its floor space, in square feet.

state.description: For signup. A warehouse: the two-letter state of its first facility.

name: commercebook_account_start
title: Open an account
